title: Tooltips for items within containers aren't scaled
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.6.2 ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Ubuntu 25.10 25.10 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, renoir, ACO, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-23-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 13.50 GiB memory ### Issue description The docs state that a tooltip should scale according to its item's scale. However, if that item is within a container, its scale always reads as 1, even if the container itself was scaled up or down. As far as I can tell, there's no way to get the "real" overall scale in order to pass it to the tooltip manually, either. This is the simplest case; the same issue persists with more complicated setups (like a scaled root node with multiple containers & instantiated scenes within); it affects both regular and custom tooltips. Here's a screenshot from the MRP: the Panel on the left rests within an HBoxContainer that is scaled to 0.5. The tooltip has the same size as the one for the Panel on the right. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create any Container 2. Add any UI element to the container (Label, Panel etc) 3. Set tooltip text for the element 4. Scale the Container to anything but 1.0 ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [tooltip_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27314908/tooltip_mrp.zip)
